notes: Normalized archetype balancing system. Each stat is on a 1-10 scale. Total budget (sum of 5 stats) ranges from 5.0 (T1L1) to 47.5 (T5L10), giving average stat of 1.0 to 9.5. Archetype profiles distribute the total budget across 5 stats (weights sum to 1.0). ±2% flavor variance makes each car feel subtly different within its archetype. Car rating = average stat × 100.

guardian.description: Heavy Hitter / Tank — Slow off the line but reaches the highest speeds. When they boost, it's devastating. Best on long straights, punishes opponents who can't keep up. Weakest acceleration in the game.

phantom.description: Speed Demon — Explosive acceleration and strong top speed. Gets to full speed faster than anyone. Wins by maintaining pace and accelerating out of corners. Weakest boost power — relies on raw speed, not nitro.

arcanist.description: Tactical Driver — Best handling and constant boost availability. Wins through clean lines, never losing speed in corners, and always having boost ready. Slowest on straights but never wastes a second in turns.
